item.title: CollectWise (YC F24) Is Hiring
item.description:
📝 CollectWise is hiring an AI Agent Engineer to build the infrastructure, prompting systems, and core architecture behind our voice AI agents. You will work at the intersection of AI infrastructure, prompt engineering, conversational design, and product development to build voice agents that power millions of consumer interactions. CollectWise is revolutionizing debt recovery with autonomous AI agents and an integrated legal network.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/collectwise/jobs/oEAfzBS-ai-agent-engineer

item.title: NHS apologises and admits Palantir have access to identifiable patient data
item.description:
📝 0 The central health service body has acknowledged the inaccuracy of claims previously made in a transparency document which indicated that only NHS staff were able to see such sensitive information NHS England has issued an apology after admitting that employees from Palantir and other suppliers can access identifiable information related to individual patients via the Federated Data Platform. Recent reports, however, have claimed that representatives from the platform’s core supplier, Palantir, can also access this sensitive data. “We recognise that the DPIA contained an error in how it described supplier access to data so we are correcting that error, and we apologise for any confusion this has caused,” the NHS said.
🔗 Read more: https://www.publictechnology.net/2026/08/03/health-and-social-care/nhs-apologises-and-admits-palantir-engineers-have-access-to-identifiable-patient-data/
